Container.Name: KaraokeDock
Container.Overview:
KaraokeDock is a self-hosted karaoke system with singer requests, live host controls, rotation and history, MP4 and CDG+MP3 playback, online karaoke search, and break-music playlists.
Requires a separate PostgreSQL database; create the database and user before starting. On default bridge networking, use the Unraid server IP and PostgreSQL's published host port. Container-name DNS requires a shared user-defined Docker network.
Set WEB_APP_URL and ORIGIN to the actual browser-facing URL, not localhost. Trusted HTTPS is required for Google/Facebook sign-in and Host PWA installation. OIDC and optional social login are configured in Admin.
First startup runs database migrations and logs a generated administrator password when creating the initial account. The WebUI opens Admin; use /host for show controls, /player for the display, and /requests for singers. Add /media/karaoke and /media/breakmusic in Admin, then scan. Periodic scanning is enabled separately in Admin.
Keep downloads, uploaded images, exported playlists, and PostgreSQL data on persistent storage. Back up the database before upgrades. Setup and troubleshooting: https://github.com/haggardj2/KaraokeDock/blob/main/docs/unraid_readme.md

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface, API, and WebSocket connections. Only one app port is needed.

Config.Name: Karaoke Tracks
Config.Description: Karaoke media, mounted read-only. Add /media/karaoke as a library in Admin. Supports MP4, ZIP CDG+MP3, and loose CDG+MP3 pairs.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Persistent writable folder for downloaded/imported tracks. Must be writable by the container.

Config.Name: Break Music
Config.Description: Optional break music, mounted read-only. Add /media/breakmusic as a break-music folder in Admin.

Config.Name: Uploaded Images
Config.Description: Persistent writable storage for uploaded player background images. Keep this mapping when recreating or upgrading the container.

Config.Name: Exported Playlists
Config.Description: Persistent writable storage for break-music M3U exports. Saved playlist definitions and ordering remain in PostgreSQL.

Config.Name: Database Host
Config.Description: Required: Unraid server IP on default bridge networking, or PostgreSQL container name only when both containers share a user-defined Docker network.

Config.Name: Database Port
Config.Description: Use PostgreSQL's published host port when DB_HOST is the Unraid IP. Use its internal service port (usually 5432) when connecting by container name.

Config.Name: Database Name
Config.Description: Existing PostgreSQL database. Startup applies schema migrations; the database user must be allowed to create tables and required extensions.

Config.Name: Database User
Config.Description: PostgreSQL login for the KaraokeDock database.

Config.Name: Database Password
Config.Description: Required: password for the PostgreSQL user. Enter the actual password, not a URL-encoded value.

Config.Name: Web App URL
Config.Description: Required: browser-facing origin, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5173 or https://karaoke.example.com. No /host or /admin suffix. Use trusted HTTPS for social sign-in and PWA installation.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Required: exact browser origins separated by commas, including scheme and port. Include WEB_APP_URL and any LAN URL used. Do not use paths or a wildcard.

Config.Name: Media Probe Concurrency
Config.Description: Optional parallel metadata probes. Blank selects automatically based on CPU count (10-24). Suggested: 4 cores 8-12, 6 cores 12-16, 8+ cores 16-24. Lower if CPU or storage is overloaded.

Config.Name: Media Scan Interval (ms)
Config.Description: Delay between periodic media-library scans in milliseconds; 900000 is 15 minutes. Enable periodic media scanning in Admin separately. Must be a positive integer.

Config.Name: Media Root
Config.Description: Root media path inside the container. Keep /media with the supplied path mappings.

Config.Name: Image Uploads Directory
Config.Description: Internal upload directory; must match the writable Uploaded Images mapping.

Config.Name: Break Playlist Export Directory
Config.Description: Default internal M3U export directory. If overridden in Admin, that folder must also have a persistent writable mapping.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Use false for direct LAN access. For a reverse proxy, configure trusted proxy IPs/CIDRs or the correct hop count (often 1). Restrict direct access when trusting forwarded headers.
